scope_limit: Direct asset test on exact candidate source with final full-build dist; this invocation does not independently rerun the clean Nest emission phase.

npm_gate_observation.command: npm run prepare:chat && nest build && node test/build-assets.integration.mjs
npm_gate_observation.intent: Verify canonical common/OCR schema assets directly after clean Nest emission, before post-build repair.
npm_gate_observation.risk: When an existing dist bundle predates approved source/registry changes, this isolated npm gate can preserve that older publication while its two schema assertions pass. It requires an existing dist knowledge bundle. It is not a complete release build or a readonly verification.
npm_gate_observation.ordered_plan91_assessment: Plan91 already calls npm run build first. With no intervening source change, context:prepare copies that freshly published bundle; stale publication is not asserted for the adopted candidate.
npm_gate_observation.recommendation: Treat test:build-assets as a dedicated clean-emission gate in a disposable build workspace; package releases only from full npm run build with all postbuilders and publication checks.
